scenes.conflict: Each plan sacrifices what another values most, and the shareholder mandate makes any concession a personal liability. Distrust left over from the audit dispute blocks compromise.
scenes.goal: Each head tries to win the council to their plan: Varga wants communication with Tithe, Adeyemi wants capture, Okoro wants a seal.
scenes.outcome: The council deadlocks. Each head leaves with a fragile, informal claim: Varga keeps pen access, Adeyemi gets a foundry preparation order, and Okoro gets authority over Brine Gate seals.
scenes.summary: In the Ledger Atrium, the three department heads meet as shareholder feeds flash valuations beside infection reports. Varga demands access to Mother Tithe, Adeyemi demands capture, and Okoro demands a hull seal. Old resentments from the Quarterly Audit Dispute surface.
scenes.title: Emergency Session

scenes.conflict: Varga's scientific detachment makes her treat Nessa as a subject, and Nessa cannot separate her own wishes from the hive's. The Choir demands the pens be opened.
scenes.goal: Varga wants to understand how the signal spreads and whether the person inside the Choir can be reached. Nessa, as the Choir's voice, wants the pens opened.
scenes.outcome: Varga confirms that proximity to the hum drives the hive link and that the Choir will push toward the pens. Nessa's flat refusal to answer to her name shows how deep the absorption goes.
scenes.summary: Varga goes to the Helix Decks to examine the first infected crew. She finds Nessa Roark, her former trainee, speaking only in plural with the Choir. Varga observes that the hum links them only within hearing range.
scenes.title: The Humming Decks

scenes.conflict: Workers are showing symptoms and some refuse shifts. Adeyemi's greed disguised as duty keeps him from treating the outbreak as a danger to himself. Halcyon's quota culture leaves his deputy overworked and exposed to recycled water.
scenes.goal: Prepare the vaults to hold Mother Tithe intact with her glands preserved before Meridian can seal the station.
scenes.outcome: Adeyemi pushes the vault prep through by threatening the crews with liability. His deputy begins drinking and handling recycled foundry water, which carries the pheromone.
scenes.summary: Adeyemi inspects the cold-storage vaults and readies the foundry to receive Mother Tithe. He uses contract leverage to commandeer foundry crews and dismisses reports of sick workers as acceptable losses.
scenes.title: Guarding the Stockpile

scenes.conflict: Her duty to the insurers pushes her to seal, while she is haunted by the crew she has already shut away. Her rigid rule-following blinds her to alternatives.
scenes.goal: Seal infected sections and keep control of Brine Gate so no infected person or sample reaches the surface.
scenes.outcome: The first section is sealed and the quarantine begins. The sealed crew start humming through the hull, which unsettles her and raises the stakes for everyone.
scenes.summary: Okoro seals a Helix Decks section at Brine Gate control after infection reports, locking the infected crew inside. She reviews forensic evidence on how the spread follows station water. The sled's docking schedule is the only way out.
scenes.title: Sealing the First Section

scenes.conflict: The Choir blocks Varga's sonar handling while Varga's obsession with the creature makes her push on despite risk. Nessa's hive voice and her fading memory fight each other.
scenes.goal: Varga wants controlled communication with Mother Tithe. Nessa and the Choir want to open the pens.
scenes.outcome: Varga records Tithe's signal pattern and sees that the Choir can be spoken to. She leaves shaken, with partial data that she is unwilling to share with her rivals.
scenes.summary: Varga enters the Trench Pens to find her assistant among the Choir and to attempt communication with Mother Tithe. She hears him speak in Tithe's rhythm and realizes the cost of her detachment.
scenes.title: Into the Deepest Pen

scenes.conflict: Adeyemi's pride and flaw make him treat his deputy as a loss. His private fear that the quota culture caused the disaster collides with his need to keep his legitimacy.
scenes.goal: Adeyemi wants to keep the foundry running and the vaults ready for Tithe. Nessa and the Choir move to spread the signal and weaken the foundry.
scenes.outcome: Adeyemi realizes the vaults and ledgers cannot save him. He resolves to move on the creature faster, and the foundry staff start to desert.
scenes.summary: Adeyemi's deputy begins to hum in the foundry. The pheromone has reached the recycled water supply. Adeyemi realizes that the stockpile cannot protect him.
scenes.title: The Deputy Hums

scenes.conflict: Contract breach carries personal liability, so every concession risks ruin. Varga's guilt and secrecy, Adeyemi's greed and Okoro's rigidity all complicate the vote.
scenes.goal: Each wants council authority for their plan: Varga wants a communication window, Adeyemi wants a capture, Okoro wants the full seal.
scenes.outcome: The council splits. Okoro takes unilateral authority over the hulls, Adeyemi launches a capture attempt, and Varga is given only a short window.
scenes.summary: The heads reconvene at the Ledger Atrium. Adeyemi demands a capture operation, Okoro threatens to seal the Trench Pens, and Varga reveals only part of her signal data. Shareholder feeds push each toward a harder line.
scenes.title: Shareholder Showdown

scenes.conflict: Okoro's rigid rule-following collides with the evidence that sealing worsens the spread. Nessa's hive loyalty drives the Choir toward a violent breach.
scenes.goal: Okoro wants to contain the infection and keep the hulls sealed. Nessa and the Choir want to breach the quarantine and open the pens.
scenes.outcome: Okoro's certainty cracks, though she keeps the seal. The Choir learns the hull layout and marks the Trench Pens as the breach target.
scenes.summary: Okoro seals a larger Helix Decks section and hears the sealed crew hum through the hull. She realizes that quarantine concentrates the infection instead of stopping it. Nessa's Choir begins coordinating a breach.
scenes.title: Humming Through the Hull

scenes.conflict: All three goals collide in one place. Adeyemi's disregard for worker deaths, Varga's obsession and the Choir's hive impulse turn the operation into a disaster.
scenes.goal: Adeyemi wants Tithe captured intact. Varga wants her kept alive and communicating. Nessa and the Choir want the pens open.
scenes.outcome: The capture fails, workers die and Tithe is agitated. Adeyemi retreats with his plan in ruins and Varga sees the Choir will negotiate only if spoken to as people.
scenes.summary: Adeyemi leads a capture team into the Trench Pens to net Mother Tithe. Varga's short window overlaps with the attempt, and the Choir moves to stop it. Sonar restraints fail and workers are lost.
scenes.title: The Capture Attempt

scenes.conflict: All four agendas collide at the pens. Each plan sacrifices what another values most, and the shareholder mandate threatens everyone with personal liability.
scenes.goal: Varga wants communication with Tithe and a non-lethal outcome. Adeyemi wants capture. Okoro wants the seal held. Nessa and the Choir want the pens opened.
scenes.outcome: Nessa's memory surfaces and she answers to her name. The Choir pauses, and the three heads are forced to face that no single plan can work.
scenes.summary: With the sled due and the Choir marching on the pens, Okoro seals the hulls, Adeyemi attempts one last capture, and Varga stands between them calling Nessa by name. She shows Nessa an old shift photo to reach the person inside the Choir.
scenes.title: Confrontation at the Pens

scenes.conflict: Each head must accept personal liability and loss of a core value. Varga's life work will be shared and lost. Adeyemi's patent claim is at stake, and Okoro must break her containment rule.
scenes.goal: Varga wants to halt the spread through a negotiated release. Nessa wants the leviathans freed without violence. Adeyemi and Okoro each have to decide what they will give up to stop the collapse.
scenes.outcome: Varga trades her research and Nessa agrees to a staged release. Adeyemi hands over the vault keys while hiding a sample, and Okoro commits to opening the Brine Gate for the sled.
scenes.summary: Varga negotiates openly with Nessa, trading her research for a staged, non-lethal release of the leviathans. Adeyemi gives Varga the cold-storage vault keys, giving up exclusive claim to Tithe, though he keeps a hidden sample. Okoro opens the Brine Gate controls to the sled evacuation of uninfected staff.
scenes.title: Terms with the Choir

scenes.conflict: The release risks injuring the infected and the staff, and Adeyemi's hidden sample and Varga's grief over losing her work create tension.
scenes.goal: Release the leviathans without killing workers and weaken the hive link through distance.
scenes.outcome: The leviathans leave and the hum fades for those moved out of range, though not everyone recovers. Varga's research is gone, and Nessa keeps her name.
scenes.summary: Nessa and the Choir lead the staged opening of the pens while Varga uses her sonar handling and signal data to guide the leviathans out. Adeyemi's crews and the vault keys support the process. Mother Tithe's signal weakens as distance grows between her and the Choir.
scenes.title: The Staged Release

scenes.conflict: Okoro's mandate and haunted conscience pull against each other, and Adeyemi's hidden sample forces her to choose whether to enforce the quarantine on him.
scenes.goal: Okoro wants to evacuate the uninfected without carrying the infection to the surface. Adeyemi wants to keep his claim and his sample.
scenes.outcome: The sled leaves with uninfected staff and Okoro accepts the liability. Adeyemi's concealed sample is a loose thread, and his career is over.
scenes.summary: Okoro opens Brine Gate controls and evacuates uninfected staff on the arriving sled, accepting personal liability. Adeyemi watches his exclusive claim end and his hidden sample is the only one that leaves.
scenes.title: The Sled Departs

scenes.conflict: The shareholder mandate and personal liability still bind the heads, and the Choir's survivors have no legal standing.
scenes.goal: Account for what was lost and decide what the station becomes. Varga wants the Choir treated as people, and Okoro wants to take responsibility for her choice.
scenes.outcome: Okoro accepts liability, Varga commits to staying with the Choir, and Nessa helps those who still hum. The station survives, changed and uncertain.
scenes.summary: In the emptied Ledger Atrium, the heads face the shareholder feeds. The valuation screens show losses, and each faces personal liability. Varga and Nessa remain as the station's new, uncertain future.
scenes.title: Final Accounting

logline: When the colony's largest bio-engineered leviathan spreads a contagious sentience that turns workers into a hive mind, three rival department heads, each bound to different shareholders, must choose between saving Mariana Six, securing the creature for patents, or sealing the station before the next resupply sled arrives.
theme: Survival demands shared sacrifice over private gain
title: Abyssal Shares
